result.summary: The page is largely well-composed: header, search, category chips, promo banner, carousels and bottom nav all align to a consistent grid. The only visually broken-looking element (aside from the intentionally scrollable carousel edge and the viewport-cut card at the bottom, which are expected behaviors) is a duplicated restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' row, where the exact same 'Green Bowl Poké' card (image, title, time badge and delivery fee) appears twice side by side, making the row look like a rendering/data duplication bug.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the first two cards are identical duplicates of 'Green Bowl Poké' (same illustration, same '15–25 min' badge, same '€0.90 delivery' line), which reads as a list-rendering or data duplication defect and wastes a visible slot in the row.
issues.suggestion: De-duplicate the carousel data source (e.g., key items by restaurant ID) or replace the second instance with a different restaurant so each card in the row is unique.
